description: This file defines a TimeoutManager class used for managing and enforcing timeouts during test execution, including handling of different test phases, fixtures, and hooks within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: TimeoutManager
classes.description: Manages test timeouts, including setting, ignoring, and interrupting timeouts, and creating timeout errors based on test phases.

classes.name: TimeoutManagerError
classes.description: Custom error class used for timeout-related errors.

methods.name: setIgnoreTimeouts
methods.description: Sets the manager to ignore all timeouts.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Rejects the current timeout promise to interrupt a running test.

methods.name: isTimeExhaustedFor
methods.description: Checks if the allotted time for a given runnable has been exhausted.

methods.name: withRunnable
methods.description: Runs a given async callback within a timeout context, managing start, end, and timeout handling.

methods.name: _updateTimeout
methods.description: Updates the timeout timer based on the current slot and elapsed time.

methods.name: slow
methods.description: Increases the current slot timeout by a factor of three.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets a new timeout value for the current slot.

methods.name: currentSlotDeadline
methods.description: Returns the deadline timestamp for the current slot.

methods.name: currentSlotType
methods.description: Returns the type of the current runnable.

methods.name: _createTimeoutError
methods.description: Creates a detailed timeout error message based on the current runnable and slot.
